new_work_order.title: How do you create a new work order for a vehicle?
new_work_order.summary: The steps to open an official job and receive the car at the center.
new_work_order.step1: Go to the work orders list (/app/work-orders) and click the "New Work Order" button.
new_work_order.step2: Choose the customer by name or mobile number, or click "Add a new customer" to register them on the spot.
new_work_order.step3: Choose the vehicle that belongs to the customer and enter the current odometer reading (in kilometers).
new_work_order.step4: Add the customer complaint, the initial inspection notes, and attach photos of the vehicle if there are any.
new_work_order.step5: Set the expected delivery date and time, then click "Save" to create the work order.
new_work_order.tip: You can attach photos of the vehicle damage and document the scratches with the vehicle inspection feature before the repair starts.

services_parts.title: Add the services and the spare parts to the work order
services_parts.summary: Price the labor and link the parts that are taken from the warehouse.
services_parts.step1: From the work order page, go to the "Services" tab.
services_parts.step2: Click "Add a service" and choose the department (mechanics, electrical, quick service).
services_parts.step3: Set the price, the quantity and the discount, if there is one.
services_parts.step4: In the spare parts section, pick the part that is taken from the warehouse; it is deducted from the stock automatically once the work order is approved.
services_parts.tip: You can assign the lines of the work order to ready-made packages with one click to speed things up.

quality.title: Quality check (QC) and the vehicle delivery
quality.summary: Verify that every line is complete and approve the vehicle release.
quality.step1: Once the technicians finish all the lines, the work order status turns to "Ready for QC".
quality.step2: The workshop supervisor reviews the inspection lines and approves them or sends them back with a note.
quality.step3: Once approved, the final invoice can be issued and the work order closed so the car can leave.

kanban.title: Use the workshop kanban board and follow the technicians
kanban.summary: Manage the floor work on the big screen inside the service bay.
kanban.step1: Go to the workshop board path (/app/workshop).
kanban.step2: The four workflow columns are shown: waiting, in progress, on hold, and ready for the quality check.
kanban.step3: The top of the board shows the summary of today's upcoming appointments and the quick check-in button.
kanban.step4: The cards update by themselves and show the name of the technician on the job and the elapsed time.

labor.title: Record the working hours with the technician timer (Labor Timers)
labor.summary: Measure the real productivity of every technician with the start and stop buttons.
labor.step1: The technician opens their account and picks the line they are working on.
labor.step2: They press the "Start Work" button to start the seconds counter.
labor.step3: During a break or while waiting for a spare part, they press "Pause".
labor.step4: When the repair is done they press "End", and the total effective hours is saved automatically in the technician report.
labor.tip: The system does not let a technician run two timers at the same time, which prevents clashes and keeps the productivity accurate.

portal.title: How does the customer sign in to their own portal?
portal.summary: A secure sign in with the mobile number through an OTP code, with no password needed.
portal.step1: The customer visits the link that belongs to the center: /{tenant_slug}/portal.
portal.step2: They enter the mobile number registered in the system and receive a 4-digit OTP code by SMS.
portal.step3: After the verification, a dedicated dashboard opens with their cars and their past and upcoming appointments.
portal.tip: The customer portal is security-isolated from the center staff dashboard and works smoothly on phone screens.

booking.title: Book a new maintenance appointment and reschedule it yourself
booking.summary: Let the customer pick the branch, the services and the time that suits them.
booking.step1: The customer presses the "Book an appointment" button.
booking.step2: They pick their car, the nearest branch and the services they need.
booking.step3: They pick the date and the time that is available according to the capacity of the service bays.
booking.step4: The customer gets an instant notification with the booking number, and can change or cancel the appointment from the same page.

tax_invoice.title: Issue the tax invoice and collect the amounts
tax_invoice.summary: Issue the simplified tax invoice that meets the ZATCA, tax and customs requirements.
tax_invoice.step1: From the finished work order page, click the "Approve and issue the invoice" button.
tax_invoice.step2: The system calculates the 15% VAT automatically and generates the QR code.
tax_invoice.step3: Choose the payment method: cash, card, credit card, bank transfer, or on account.
tax_invoice.step4: Print the invoice on the fast thermal printer or on the approved A4 size.
tax_invoice.tip: The system supports printing the encrypted barcode that the official ZATCA verification app expects.

stock.title: Manage the warehouses and stocktake the spare parts
stock.summary: Follow the stock movement, the low-stock alerts and the warehouse reconciliations.
stock.step1: From the inventory list (/app/inventory/stock), browse all the parts and their balances in each warehouse.
stock.step2: You can create a new purchase order for the supplier when a part reaches its minimum order quantity.
stock.step3: When the goods arrive, record a goods received note (GRN) so the balances are updated automatically.

bays.title: Schedule the service bays (lifts) and manage the capacity
bays.summary: Prevent clashes and calculate the daily capacity of the center lifts.
bays.step1: Learn about the center lifts and the service spots on the service bays page (/app/service-bays).
bays.step2: When any appointment is booked, the system checks that the bay, the technician and the vehicle are free at that time.
bays.step3: When the customer arrives, click "Check in", then "Convert to Work Order" with a single click.
